concept: CloudTrail: auditing KMS API calls (who decrypted and when)
tests: Which service records who called KMS Decrypt and when for SSE-KMS objects.
expected: AWS CloudTrail logs KMS API calls (Decrypt) with principal, time and key. Triggers: "prove who decrypted and when", "compliance audits", SSE-KMS.
why_not: Config is configuration state, not individual API calls; Macie finds sensitive data; Inspector is vulnerabilities.
